title.zh: 【美 SEC 拟为加密资产托管建立专门监管框架，提出新提案】
title.en: 【美 SEC 拟为加密资产托管建立专门监管框架，提出新提案】

current_state.zh: The U.S. SEC proposed a new regulatory framework governing crypto asset custody by investment advisers and regulated funds, establishing a compliance path under pre-internet rules, permitting state trust companies to serve as custodians, and allowing adviser self-custody in limited cases where no qualified custodian exists.
current_state.en: The U.S. SEC proposed a new regulatory framework governing crypto asset custody by investment advisers and regulated funds, establishing a compliance path under pre-internet rules, permitting state trust companies to serve as custodians, and allowing adviser self-custody in limited cases where no qualified custodian exists.
